root_cause: The refactor in commit 63ea1660fa ("avcodec/mm: decode partial palette") replaced a previous fixed 128-iteration loop with a stream-controlled 'start' offset and 'count' loop bound, but failed to mask/clamp the resulting array index (start+i) to the valid range of the palette array, allowing attacker-controlled values to index arbitrarily far outside the array.
findings: mm_decode_pal() reads a 16-bit 'start' offset and a 16-bit 'count' directly from the bitstream (both attacker-controlled, up to 65535) and then writes 'count' consecutive unsigned ints into s->palette[start+i] without ever validating that start+i stays within the bounds of the palette array (unsigned int palette[AVPALETTE_COUNT], i.e. 256 entries).
